text: Binary: 1 if at least one other-user comment (from OC_comments, a JSON list to parse) directly argues about the OP's main premise/central claim itself, rather than targeting a specific OP example or anecdote; 0 if none does. The premise is identified from the OP's title and argument, which serve as context only. Any-comment aggregation, and comment order is irrelevant. Empty valid comment list -> 0; missing or malformed OC_comments, or missing OP text needed to identify the premise -> null. Ignore OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even inside the argument; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not ignored. Use the current supplied text and do not infer initial snapshots.
